title: beste
brief: Beste UI is a collection of production-ready shadcn/tailwind blocks and components — 2189+ blocks (heroes, pricing, testimonials, error pages) and 1326+ smaller pieces, each self-contained and installed with one shadcn CLI command and no runtime dependency. Free pieces are MIT-licensed for commercial use; Pro blocks need a Beste UI license, though installed code keeps working if the license lapses.
details: Beste UI is a curated collection of production-ready shadcn/tailwind blocks and components for React 19 — 2189+ full page sections (heroes, feature grids, pricing tables, testimonials, error pages, plus elaborate WebGL/Canvas showpieces like a CRT broadcast hero and a starling murmuration) and 1326+ smaller composable pieces. Every piece is self-contained and installs with a one-line shadcn CLI command that writes files into your components directory, registers shadcn primitives, and installs npm packages; there is no runtime dependency and no upgrade path to fight. Free blocks are MIT-licensed for commercial use; Pro blocks need a Beste UI license, though installed code keeps working if the license lapses. From @withbeste.
